nodes.description: Public mapping (address => uint) recording each hodler's deposited balance; read and written in the fallback deposit and in party().
Constant uint partyTime = 1749995999 acting as the release timestamp gate for the party() withdrawal.
Anonymous payable fallback function that credits hodlers[msg.sender] with msg.value and emits Hodl.
party() function that requires block.timestamp > partyTime and a positive balance, zeroes the balance and transfers it to msg.sender.
msg.sender used in the fallback function as the mapping key for the deposit credit.
block.timestamp compared against partyTime in party() to gate the withdrawal.
msg.sender used in party() as balance owner and recipient of the payout.
Unchecked arithmetic update hodlers[msg.sender] += msg.value in the fallback function (overflow/underflow risk).
External value transfer msg.sender.transfer(value) performed after state reset, exposing a reentrancy/force-feed pattern.
Local variable value in party() caching hodlers[msg.sender] before it is zeroed and transferred.

edges.reason: msg.sender from the fallback is used as the key to index and write the hodlers mapping.
msg.sender feeds the unchecked arithmetic statement hodlers[msg.sender] += msg.value.
The current hodlers balance is read and mutated by the addition, making the balance arithmetic overflow-prone.
msg.sender in party() is used as the key to read and then zero the hodlers mapping entry.
The stored balance hodlers[msg.sender] is copied into the local variable value.
The locally cached value is the amount sent out via the external transfer in the unsafe operation.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external transfer, giving the caller control flow during withdrawal.
block.timestamp controls whether party() passes its require gate, creating timestamp dependency.
partyTime is the constant bound compared against block.timestamp to gate party() execution.
msg.sender's balance is checked in party()'s require, gating who may trigger the withdrawal.
The result of the unchecked addition is written back into the hodlers state mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: local_value is a non-core temporary that only holds hodlers[msg.sender] before it is zeroed and paid out, so it should be normalized into the external transfer unsafe operation it feeds.
